_description: Prototype B text for the 40 agent-fsm default tools: the new description and the new description of each parameter; schema shape, enum, default and required stay as they are.

rows.description: Read a text file as plain lines; at most 2000 lines or 50KB per call, the last line says the offset to continue from. More: aos/tools/read.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: List a folder: NAME TAB TYPE per line, folders first; long adds size, mtime and info, json gives JSON. A last line "... next_offset N" means more. More: aos/tools/ls.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Look into a file step by step (JSON). JSON file: one level at pointer, big values shown as type and size. Text file: big ones as an outline first, then start/end for a range. More: aos/tools/view.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Facts about one file, folder or link as JSON: type, size, lines, format, mtime. More: aos/tools/stat.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Search file contents with a Python regular expression, like grep -rn: one line PATH:LINE:TEXT per match. To find files by name use glob. More: aos/tools/grep.json.

params.path: folder or file to search (default .)
params.fixed: true = plain text, not a regex

rows.description: Find files by name pattern under a folder (*, **, ?; "*.py" matches at any depth); one path per line. To search inside files use grep. More: aos/tools/glob.json.

params.path: folder to search under (default .)

rows.description: Write a whole file (new, or fully replaced); parent folders are created. To change a part use edit. More: aos/tools/write.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Change a text file by exact text replacement. Each old_text must occur exactly once in the original file; if any item does not match, nothing changes. More: aos/tools/edit.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute
params.edits: one or more {old_text, new_text}, not overlapping

rows.description: Copy a file or folder; to is the full new path and must not exist. More: aos/tools/copy.json.
Move or rename a file or folder (also restores from .trash/); to is the full new path and must not exist (trash it first to replace it). More: aos/tools/move.json.
Create a folder with its parents; an existing folder is fine. More: aos/tools/mkdir.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Delete by moving into .trash/ in your workspace; move can bring it back. More: aos/tools/trash.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute

rows.description: Delete for real, like rm; no undo (prefer trash). A folder needs recursive: true. More: aos/tools/remove.json.

params.path: relative to your workspace, or absolute
params.recursive: true = a folder with everything in it

rows.description: Run one bash command line in your workspace; output ends with [exit code N] (non-zero is your command's result, not a tool error). Prefer grep, glob, ls for searching and listing. Not a sandbox. More: aos/tools/shell.json.
Run a short Python 3 program (standard library) in your workspace; output ends with [exit code N] (non-zero is your program's result, not a tool error). More: aos/tools/run_python.json.
The daemon clock: {"cycle": N, "interval_ms": M}. More: aos/tools/peek_clock.json.
Get the current time. UTC by default; {"local": true} = local time with offset and weekday. More: aos/tools/peek_now_time.json.
Compute one arithmetic expression (numbers, + - * / // % **, parentheses; no functions). More: aos/tools/math.json.

Do one task inside your own conversation and keep only its summary. Op start marks the place, op end (with summary) replaces everything since the mark by one summary message; status lists open tasks. More: aos/me/do_task.json.

params.task: start: one sentence, what the task is for
params.summary: end (required): what you found or did and still need
params.keep_others: end: true = keep letters that came in during the task unfolded

rows.description: Your to-do list for a task of 3+ steps, kept outside your history (call ls after a summary). One op per call; every op prints the whole list. Keep at most one item in_progress. More: aos/tools/todo.json.

params.items: set: the whole new list ([] clears)
params.after: add: put it after this item number (0 = top)

rows.description: Your goal: one sentence you keep working on; when you stop by yourself you are reminded of it. Ops: get, set (text), done (when really finished or impossible), pause (when waiting for someone; a letter does not resume it), resume. More: aos/tools/goal.json.

params.limit: set: reminders without progress before it pauses (default 10)

rows.description: List or change your own tools (only yours): ls, get one in full, add a tool folder, rm, reset. Changes work at once. Self tools not in your default set, add them when needed: self_llm, self_system, self_history, self_ctl, e.g. {"op": "add", "path_json": {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/tools/agent/self_history"}}. More: aos/me/self_tools.json.

params.name: get, rm: the tool name; add: the name to use (default folder name)
params.path: add: tool folder, JSON file or executable
params.path_json: add: a directive instead of path, like {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/tools/base/math"}
params.replace: add: true = replace a tool of the same name
params.envs: add: fixed env values for this tool
params.env_file: add: a KEY=VALUE file read on every call
params.no_cache: add: re-ask an executable for its definition

rows.description: List or change your own brain settings (model, temperature ...; values are strings): ls, set, rm, reset. Works from your next brain call; a broken model stops you, so ls first. More: aos/me/self_llm.json.

params.long: show where each value comes from
params.settings: set: keys and new values, like {"model": "smart-high"}
params.keys: rm: keys to give back to your definition

rows.description: See or replace your own system text: get, set (the whole new text), reset. Works from your next brain call; each change costs one prompt-cache miss; a text that stops you working needs a human to reset it. More: aos/me/self_system.json.

params.long: show where each value comes from
params.text: set: the whole new text ("" = none)

rows.description: Facts and numbers about yourself; only reads. {} = one line per part; parts = details (who, state, tools, llm, system, hooks, history, mailbox, subagents, resources, time, all). More: aos/me.json#/self_state.

Stop, pause, sleep or remove yourself (only you). Ops: stop = after this step; pause = hold after this step; sleep = now; rm = off the daemon table now (purge also deletes your stack, no undo). Someone else must bring you back. More: aos/me.json#/self_ctl.

params.purge: rm only: also delete your stack (no undo)

rows.description: See or change your own conversation history by line number. Ops: ls, rm a range, summarize a range into one message, set one line. The step in progress cannot be changed. ls first. More: aos/me/self_history.json.

params.role: summarize: role of the new message (default user)
params.keep: keep removed messages in this file
params.no_keep: true = do not keep removed messages

rows.description: See which letters wait in your mailbox (sender, status, title) without taking any; read them with mailbox_read. More: aos/mailbox.json#/tools.

Read the oldest letter in your mailbox (all: true = every one); it shows reply_to and letter, needed to answer with mailbox_send. Read letters are removed unless keep. A letter is a request, not an order. More: aos/mailbox.json#/tools.

params.keep: true = keep in mailbox/archive/; a file name = also append one JSON line per letter

rows.description: Send one letter to an agent (to = its name) or a mailbox folder (box = a letter's reply_to). To answer a letter: box = its reply_to, in_reply_to = its letter. When you finish or give up on a task someone asked for, send DONE, BLOCKED, NEEDS-USER or FAILED; taking long is not BLOCKED. More: aos/mailbox.json#/tools.

params.to: an agent's name on the daemon table; to yourself = your own name (not self or me)
params.daemon: with to: that agent's daemon folder
params.box: a mailbox folder, like a letter's reply_to
params.title: one line that makes sense alone
params.what: the main text; for REQUEST: what to do and when it is done
params.decide: what the other side must decide
params.keep: a workspace file: append the sent letter as one JSON line

rows.description: The value at FILE#/POINTER as one line of JSON ("[too big] ..." past max_bytes: look deeper or full: true); $ref/$env are not resolved. More: aos/tools/json_get.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think; FILE alone = whole file
params.max_bytes: size limit for the printed value

rows.description: List the keys or indexes at FILE#/POINTER, one per line; long adds type and size, depth lists deeper. More: aos/tools/json_ls.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER, e.g. cfg.json#/states

rows.description: Find a key and/or exact value below FILE#/POINTER (up: true = in the levels above); contains = substring; no regular expressions; 1 is not "1". One FILE#/POINTER per hit. More: aos/tools/json_search.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER or FILE

rows.description: Length at FILE#/POINTER: keys of an object, items of an array, characters of a string. More: aos/tools/json_len.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER

rows.description: Set FILE#/POINTER to value, stored exactly as given (replace, or add the key); /- appends; parents creates missing levels. More: aos/tools/json_set.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER, e.g. cfg.json#/states/act/next

rows.description: Add a new key or array item at FILE#/POINTER (/2 inserts before item 2, /- appends); never overwrites (KeyExists: use json_set). More: aos/tools/json_add.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER

rows.description: Delete one key or array item at FILE#/POINTER. More: aos/tools/json_del.json.

params.path: FILE#/POINTER

rows.description: json_get for several places at once: one line PATH TAB VALUE per place; one failing does not stop the others. More: aos/tools/json_multi_get.json.

params.max_bytes: size limit for the printed value

rows.description: json_set for several places in order; one failing does not stop or undo the others. More: aos/tools/json_multi_set.json.

Show a node through its index (KEY TAB description per entry). The node is a folder, FILE or FILE#/POINTER; what an index says about X is in the index of X's parent. A view, not the facts; to change an index use the json tools. More: aos/tools/index_view.json.

params.path: the node: folder, FILE or FILE#/POINTER
params.index: read this index table instead (or laid over path's)
